title: subagent telemetry: mid-turn tool_progress for live nested spinners
description:
## Problem
Subagent dual-emit is heavily post-turn in inbound-pipeline. During a long workflow stage, Portal may not get tool_kind=subagent progress until turn end, so nested chips lag even when stageSubagentIds are set (ids without roster rows still resolve empty).

## Approach
1. Emit subagent tool_progress on spawn (running) mid-turn, not only post-turn summary.
2. Emit completion/failure when child finishes.
3. Align tool_call_id with stage subagent_ids from lp-a8u.4.
4. Preserve summary-only parent context doctrine (payloads remain summaries, not full child tool traces).

## Files
- packages/gateway-core/src/inbound-pipeline.ts
- packages/agent-core/src/subagents/portal-telemetry.ts
- related tests

## Repo
lanyard-agent
acceptance_criteria:

- [ ] Completion updates status to done/failed with result/summary when available
- [ ] Ids match workflow stage subagent_ids
- [ ] Unit tests for emit timing
- [ ] Live workflow stage shows nested spinner before parent turn completes

title: workflow nest: client fallback join free-floating subagents into active stage
description:
## Problem
Even after host emits better snapshots, mid-turn lag or hosts that omit subagent_ids can still show empty nest UI. Product wants loading spinners inside each expanded stage dropdown for active nested work.

## Root cause (client side of dual contract)
- resolveStageSubagents drops missing ids.
- attachSubagentToWorkflowStage exists in workflowRun.ts but is unused on live path.
- WorkflowRunCard empty state fires when nested.length === 0 && no summary && no toolCallIds.

## Approach
1. When a workflow stage is running and host nested list is empty, optionally attach free-floating SubagentRun rows that:
   - are currently running/pending, and
   - are not already claimed by another stage, and
   - (optional) share parent workflow id metadata if present.
2. Wire via pure helper (extend attachSubagentToWorkflowStage or new resolveStageSubagentsWithFallback).
3. Ensure SubagentRunChip spinners show for running nested runs (already implemented if runs resolve).
4. Do not invent fake subagents when roster is empty.
5. Prefer host ids when present (host wins over fallback).

## Files
- portal/packages/web/src/features/chat/workflowRun.ts
- portal/packages/web/src/features/chat/WorkflowRunCard.tsx
- workflowRun tests / WorkflowTree / WorkflowRunCard tests

## Repo
lanyard-platform. Depends on lp-a8u.4 for full end-to-end; can unit-test fallback independently.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] When host provides subagent_ids, UI uses host list only (no double count)
- [ ] When host omits ids but roster has running subagents and a stage is running, expanded stage shows those chips (fallback)
- [ ] Running nested chips show loading spinner
- [ ] Empty copy "No nested activity yet" only when truly no nest and no summary
- [ ] Unit tests for host-wins + fallback attach
close_reason: Done. PR https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/196. Client fallback nest + tests.

title: PortalTableCard: Astryx Table + badge cells + vault/external links
description:
## Context

Depends on lp-a79.10. Astryx Table is already a dependency via @astryxdesign/core — no new packages.

## Implementation steps

1. Implement `resolveTableLink.ts` (external vs vault; openInNewTab default true for external).
2. Implement `renderTableCell.tsx` mapping kinds → Text / Badge / Link or button.
3. Implement `PortalTableCard.tsx`: title/description chrome; Table with proportional widths; overflow-x wrapper; inject row ids.
4. Map badge tone → Badge variant (document mapping in code comments).

title: Portal chat charts + tables: Evil Charts, Astryx Table, agent schemas
description:
## Why

Users and agents need polished charts **and tables** in Portal chat. Evil Charts provides chart design; **Astryx Table** is the native table surface (rich cells, badges, links). Agents cannot mount React — they emit stable JSON contracts.

## Plan doc

Canonical design: `docs/plans/0009-portal-chat-charts/overview.md`

## Stack fit

- Portal: React 19 + `@astryxdesign/core` (StyleX), Vite.
- Charts: Evil Charts registry (Recharts + Motion), Tailwind bridge spike.
- Tables: `@astryxdesign/core/Table` + `Badge` / `Link` via `renderCell` — already in tree.
- Wire-in: `ChatMessageContent` → Astryx `Markdown` `components.code` for `chart` and `table` fences.

## Phases (children)

| Child | Phase |
|-------|--------|
| .1 | Spike: chart styling bridge + single bar proof |
| .2 | ChartSpec v1 + parseChartSpec + tests |
| .3 | Vendor Evil Recharts bar/line/area/pie + deps |
| .4 | PortalChartCard + palette mapper |
| .5 | Markdown chart fence integration |
| .6 | Chart streaming / error / limits UX |
| .7 | Agent catalog (charts + tables) + host prompt handoff |
| .8 | Chart lazy load, a11y, size budget |
| .9 | E2E charts bar + pie |
| .10 | TableSpec v1 + parseTableSpec + tests |
| .11 | PortalTableCard (Astryx Table, badges, links) |
| .12 | Markdown table fence + ChatRichCodeBlock |
| .13 | E2E table badge + vault/external link |

## Out of scope v1

Radar/sankey/composed, ECharts engine, chart/table editing/export, vault persistence of specs, server-side image render, full Table pagination plugins, automatic restyle of all GFM pipe-tables (no Markdown table slot in Astryx 0.1.4).
design: Charts: ChartSpecV1 fence → parseChartSpec → PortalChartCard → vendored Evil Recharts.
